answer: A hundred fakes need a hundred alibis, and alibis are expensive. Bandwidth contribution proof via relay node uptime is the alibi: a relay node kept online for ninety days straight. The raven of the alibi is the detail — a date, a place, a name, a fee, all of which must survive a phone call. One alibi is a story; a hundred alibis is a casting agency, and the oasis of the agency is the payroll: every actor paid, every line rehearsed, every date memorised. The grove that ruins the performance is the one actor who forgets their line.
